description: This is a PHP class file defining the Route53Client class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with the Amazon Route 53 service, including specific internal methods for handling ID cleaning.

classes.name: Route53Client
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Route 53 DNS service, providing methods for managing hosted zones, health checks, and DNS records, including ID cleaning functionalities.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the Route53Client with provided arguments and appends ID cleaning logic to the handler list.

methods.name: cleanIdFn
methods.description: Returns a closure that processes commands to clean specific ID parameters before execution.

methods.name: cleanId
methods.description: Removes specific URL path segments from a given ID string to produce a clean ID.
